context.body: A later worship renewal measures its joy against Solomon’s era rather than against royal wealth.
context.label: Narrative or literary frame

observations.body: Judah and visiting Israelites celebrate Passover with music, teaching, confession, and extended feasting; Chronicles says Jerusalem had not known such joy since Solomon.
observations.label: Hezekiah’s Passover recalls Solomon’s joy: action

observations.body: Priests and Levites bless the people, and their prayer reaches heaven.
observations.label: Hezekiah’s Passover recalls Solomon’s joy: response

observations.body: great joy · days of Solomon · blessing · heard in heaven
observations.label: Words in 2 Chronicles 30:21–27

payload.posture: Read 2 Chronicles 30:21–27 as later memory and aftermath evidence before carrying it into another source.
payload.tension: The comparison remembers communal celebration while leaving the failures of Solomon’s reign outside this brief horizon.
payload.title: Hezekiah’s Passover recalls Solomon’s joy
